about: The three places where the pack `endless midi` (versions 3, 4 and 5: the same places) changes OS 1.7.3+0 of the OP-1 Field. No byte of the firmware is in this file: addresses and checksums only.

Each is the first eight bytes of a function (whole instructions, none of them relative to its own place), taken with the form `jump` and a room of sixteen bytes: the loader copies the eight bytes into the room with a jump back behind them. The sums were worked out by the owner from their own os.ldr (SHA-256 d134eb1a...).

patches.name: The first instructions of the firmware's MIDI note-on function: called with the message (status, note, velocity; its flags behind) for every note-on that passed the channel filter.
The first instructions of the firmware's MIDI note-off function: called with the message for every note-off, and by the note-on function for a note-on of velocity 0.
The first instructions of the function that turns a note key's number into its semitone (0 to 23, F first).

entries.does: Ours asks its own function whether this note-on is one to hand to the unit as a key press (shift held on endless's screen, synth); if so it posts the key press and returns to the caller, else it puts the registers back and jumps to its room, where the firmware's function goes on as it always did.

Ours asks its own function whether this note-off ends a note it handed on as a key press; if so it posts that key's release and returns to the caller, else it puts the registers back and jumps to its room.

Ours asks its own function, with the key and the address of the caller, whether the key is one it lent to a MIDI note and the caller is endless's own recorder; if so it answers the note's real semitone, else it puts the registers back and jumps to its room.
